import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [0.5, 1.5, 2.5]
}
df_pandas = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals DataFrame
df = nw.from_native(df_pandas)

# Convert dtypes: user_id to Int32, score to Float32
df_converted = df.with_columns([
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32()),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32())
])

print(df_converted)
print(df_converted.schema)
